title: Length after sealing gates
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $L$ be a list of indices, and let $s$ be a pair consisting of a gate list and a natural number. The gate list produced by sealing the indices in $L$ starting from $s$ has length equal to the original gate-list length plus three times the length of $L$.
hypotheses_covered: A starting pair $s$ of a gate list and a natural number
